about: Lumipol parent and egg generated with Roblox mesh generation (Studio MCP generate_mesh, text prompt only: the tool takes no image) from the user's reference image description, 2026-11-10. Templates live in ServerStorage.WildboundAssets.Lumipol as Parent and Egg: one MeshPart each (inside a 'body' sub-model), axis-aligned, pivot at the bottom centre of the bounds at the origin, every part Anchored with CanCollide, CanTouch and CanQuery off, front toward -Z. Asset ids are exactly as returned by the tool (publishedAssetId); mesh and texture ids were read from the inserted MeshParts.

Parent.prompt: Cute chibi four-legged creature on all fours like a puppy, faceted low-poly style. Oversized wide head with enormous dark blue octagon eyes with white square shine, small pink open mouth, cyan pixel freckles on cheeks. A mint-green mushroom cap with light hexagon spots covers the top of the head like a hat. Two blue antennae with glowing cyan octagonal orb tips. Three big purple translucent leaf-shaped gills fanning out on each side of the head like an axolotl. Short stout blue-teal quadruped body with mint-green chest and a glowing cyan crystal gem on the chest, four short thick legs with mint-green toes, glowing cyan spots on the back. Front view, symmetric.

Egg.prompt: Faceted low-poly fantasy creature egg standing upright, mint-green to teal gradient shell with pale mint hexagon-shaped spots, three small glowing cyan crystal shards growing from the lower shell, subtle cyan glow, chunky flat-shaded facets, cute stylized game asset

close second (big eyes, cap, antennae orbs) but no chest gem, belly or freckles
an 8-part explicit segmentation request failed moderation; nothing was produced
plain cyan shell, no hexagon spots or crystals
